legal.terms.title: Terms and conditions of use
legal.terms.intro: These terms govern the use of POS Control ("the software", "the platform"), a point of sale for food businesses provided to the company that gave you access to this account ("the company"). By signing in, you accept these terms.
legal.terms.s1: POS Control is offered to restaurants, cafés and other food businesses so they can run their day-to-day operations: the dining-room tables, kitchen orders, the cash register and direct counter sales. It is used by the team members of the company (management, cashier and floor staff); there is no end-customer portal, and the business keeps its own relationship with its guests.
legal.terms.s2a: Each user (admin, cashier or waiter) is responsible for keeping their password confidential.
legal.terms.s2b: As a security measure, access is temporarily blocked after several failed attempts at entering the company code.
legal.terms.s2c: The company that manages the account can create, edit or revoke access for its users at any time.
legal.terms.s3: POS Control is delivered on a free plan with usage limits, such as a maximum number of menu items per business. Those limits are not shown on screen: when you try to go past them, the platform warns that you need to move to the paid plan, and everything else keeps working the same. The conditions and sign-up for the paid plan are agreed directly with whoever provides the platform.
legal.terms.s4: You may not use the platform to knowingly record false sales or data, try to reach the information of a company other than your own, or try to breach the security measures of the system. Each session only sees the data of its own company.
legal.terms.s5: We aim to keep the platform continuously available, but scheduled or unscheduled interruptions may happen due to maintenance, updates or factors outside our control (for example, the database provider). The app can be installed on a phone or tablet and opens offline, but to record sales it needs to be online.
legal.terms.s6: The handling of the personal data uploaded to the platform (that of the staff of the business and that of the sales it records) is described in the Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.
legal.terms.s7Summary: the platform is provided with no guarantee of perfect or uninterrupted operation; it is used at your own risk.
legal.terms.s7: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including (but not limited to) warranties that it will work without errors, run uninterrupted, or be fit for a particular purpose. Use of the platform is at your own risk.

legal.terms.s8b: The company using the platform is responsible for the accuracy of the data it uploads, for its charging decisions (prices, tips, discounts and voids) and for its tax and accounting obligations in its own country: the platform prints receipts and closes the register, it does not replace the invoicing or the filings that apply to the business.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: POS Control is the software used by the food business that gave you access to this account to record and charge for its sales. This page explains what data the platform stores and how it is handled.
legal.privacy.rowStaffData: Name, email and role within the team (admin, cashier or waiter)
legal.privacy.rowSalesData: Dining rooms and tables, number of guests, items served, amounts, tips, discounts, payment methods and cash-register shifts
legal.privacy.rowMenuData: Sections, items, prices and the thumbnail photo of each item
legal.privacy.s1Note: No personal data of guests is recorded and there is no customer base: the platform runs the operations of the business, not its customers.
legal.privacy.s2Intro: The only image stored on the platform is the photo of a menu item:
legal.privacy.s2a: The thumbnail is compressed in the browser itself before it is uploaded (90 pixels on a side, a few kilobytes) and is stored with a randomly generated name, not the name of the item.
legal.privacy.s2Note: These images live in the same storage as the business data and are only seen from within the platform; when the photo is removed from the menu, the file is deleted.
legal.privacy.s3: The data is used solely to run the business: knowing which tables are open, sending orders to the kitchen, charging, printing the receipt and closing the register for the shift. It is not sold or shared with third parties outside the company that manages your account.
legal.privacy.s4: The data is stored in a database with access controls by user, by role and by company: each session requires a valid sign-in and one company cannot read the data of another, even if both use the same platform. Whoever provides technical support for the platform can enter a specific company when needed (for example, to export or migrate the business data), and that action is recorded.
legal.privacy.s5: The sales and register records are kept as long as the account of the company stays active. If the business stops using the platform, its data can be exported and deleted on request.
legal.privacy.s5b: The item photos are kept as long as the item stays on the menu, or until someone removes them.
legal.privacy.s6: If you want to view, correct or ask for the deletion of your personal information, contact the company that manages your account directly: it is the one with direct control of that data within the platform.
legal.privacy.s6b: Access to, correction of and deletion of your personal data are governed by the data protection legislation applicable in your country (for example, the privacy laws of the various Latin American countries or of the US states). To the extent those laws require it, we do not sell your personal information; to exercise any of these rights, contact the company.
legal.privacy.s7: This policy may be updated. Relevant changes will be reflected in the "Last updated" date on this page.
legal.privacy.contact: Questions about this policy? Contact the company that gave you access to this account, or whoever provided you with the platform.

reportes.fechasInvalidas: Choose a valid date range (the To date cannot be earlier than the From date).
reportes.fuenteLocal: The reports RPC does not respond yet; the figures were calculated on this device.
reportes.sinPermiso: Your role does not have permission to view the reports.
super.importar.notaJson: With a .json everything is recreated except the photos (products and receipts end up without an image). To take the photos with you, export «Full (.zip)».
super.importar.notaZip: Full backup (.zip): everything is recreated, with the product photos, the logo, the payment QR and the payment proofs.
super.tabla.exportarZipTitulo: Download everything: data, inventory, returns and the actual photos
agente.variasAyuda: Tick several at once and the same ticket prints on all of them. Serial mode only takes one: to duplicate over serial, create another group.
config.propinaMostrar: Show the suggested tip on the bill
config.propinaMostrarAyuda: Off: no tip is offered at checkout; the configured percentage is still used if someone types it by hand.
impresoras.ayudaUnica: Everything printed is set up here: ticket groups, where each one prints (this PC or the station), copies, footer and cutter. There is no other printing screen.
impresoras.seccionesMulti: Each section can send to several groups at once, or to all of them. A dish that reaches two groups prints in both kitchens.
impresoras.subContenidoAyuda: Here you send whole sections. Each individual dish is chosen in Items (the product area), not twice here.
impresoras.subDondeAyuda: Choose whether the devices here or the station PC print, and check each group’s output.
impresoras.subGruposAyuda: Each group is a separate output (kitchen, bar, payment ticket). Name it and pick the paper it uses.
impresoras.subPapelAyuda: Copies, footer text and cut for each group.
impresoras.subSonidoAyuda: A beep on the printer so no order goes unnoticed.
items.estaEn: "{q}" is not in {actual}, but it is in {tipo}.
items.indAlCrear: Lists are assigned when creating the instruction, in the Instructions tab.
items.indicBadge: Instructions and options for this item
items.indNinguna: No list assigned: assign them in the Instructions tab.
items.indObligarAyuda: If required, the waiter must pick at least one option when ordering.
items.indSinUso: It does not apply to any group or product yet.
items.indVacias: There are no instruction lists yet. Create the first with "+ {n}".
items.prodOpcionesNota: They show as buttons when ordering the item and print on the ticket.
items.prodOpcionesPlace: E.g. No onions, no ice, medium rare
items.tabsAria: Which list you want to see
pedido.ticketImpreso: Ticket printed on the accounts group printer.
plan.alTopeArticulos: You are at the item limit of the Basic plan. Premium removes it.
plan.alTopePersonas: You are at the people limit of the Basic plan. Premium removes it.
plan.beneficio1: No automatic deletion of old sales, tickets and movements.
plan.beneficio2: No limit on items for sale.
plan.comoSubir: How do I move to Premium?
plan.estoyBasico: I am on the Basic plan (free)
plan.estoyPremium: I am on the Premium plan
plan.laActivaSuper: The platform owner (super admin) turns it on.
plan.pedirAlSuper: Ask the owner of this platform: there is no in-app payment.
salon.llevarSinNombre: No name · write it on the order
menu.grupoImpAyuda: The printer for each group is chosen in Settings → Printing. There a section can send to several groups at once.
plan.activado: Done: the company is now Premium.
plan.vueltaBasico: Done: the company is back on the Basic plan.
plan.laActivaAqui: As super admin you can turn it on right here (days add to what is already active):
menu.costoPctAyuda: What percentage of the price will be the cost? E.g. 40 for 40 %
menu.costoPctReemplazar: Also replace items that already have a cost
menu.costoPctRango: Enter a percentage between 1 and 100 (for example 40 so the cost is 40 % of the price).
menu.costoPctNada: Nothing changes: every item already has a cost. Tick «Also replace items that already have a cost» to overwrite them.
menu.costoPctAplicado: Cost set to {n} % of the price on {total} item(s).
menu.sinCostoN: {n} products are left without a cost and are skipped.
items.selHint: Tick items in the list and use “✎ Edit” in the search bar to change several at once.
items.herrAlcanceSel: Changes apply only to the marked items.
items.herrAlcanceTodo: No item marked: the cost tools apply to the whole menu.
items.ayudaGrupos: Group = one section of the menu (Drinks, Food). Reorder with ▲▼ and rename with Edit; the group decides which printer each item goes to.
items.ayudaProductos: Each priced item. The Nº is the shortcut the waiter uses to order. Edit opens price, group, printer and cost.
items.ayudaIndicaciones: Lists of options the waiter ticks when taking the order (Doneness: rare/medium/well). Here you create the list and choose which groups or items it applies to.
items.herrPreciosNota: Raise or lower the marked prices by a percentage, or set them all to the same amount.
items.herrGrupoNota: Move the marked items to another group and choose kitchen, bar or both printers.
items.herrEstadoNota: Active = can be ordered. Inactive = hidden but kept in history. Sold out = gone today and shows the reason.
items.herrCostoNota: Cost is never charged or printed: it only feeds the profit and margin % shown here and in Reports.
items.indOpcionesNota: Each option appears as a button when ordering and prints on the ticket.
items.indReglasNota: Required: the waiter cannot accept the order without ticking at least one. Min./Max. limit how many options are ticked per item.
caja.llevarAyuda: Charge them right here, no table needed. Tap one to take payment.
caja.llevarVacio: No open takeaway orders; they are taken in Hall → 🥡 Takeaway.
caja.mesaLibre: The table is free: there is no bill to charge.
caja.editarMesaTitle: Open the waiter view: take orders, move or delete items
caja.modoCobroAyuda: Charging view: the bill and what is still owed. “✎ Edit table” opens the waiter view.
caja.mesasAyuda: Shows each table’s balance; tap one to charge it. Orders are taken in the Hall.
caja.turnoAyuda: Shift = how long the drawer stays open: float + charged + income − expenses = Expected.
caja.movimientosAyuda: Money in or out that is not a sale (purchases, withdrawals); it counts in the closing.
caja.ticketsAyuda: Bills already paid in this shift, from tables and from the counter.
caja.cierreAyuda: Count the drawer and compare it with the Expected cash; confirming downloads the PDF report.
venta.ayuda: Counter: the customer orders, pays and leaves — no table, no open bill. Tables are charged in Cash.
cocina.areasAyuda: Each tab is a working area with its own printer (set up in Settings → Printing).
cocina.sacadasAyuda: Orders that left the pass complete; ↩ sends a dish back to preparation.
cocina.devueltoAyuda: Dishes returned after being served: confirm them here so Cash can deduct them.
reportes.periodoAyuda: Every section uses the selected range; with manual dates, tap “Apply”.
reportes.tablasAyuda: Tap a header to sort the column (▲, then ▼); drag its edge to resize.
alertas.filtrosAyuda: The type says who the alert is for (kitchen, cash, stock, tables); it is only a filter.
salon.llevarAyuda: Orders to be picked up, no table: charge them here or from Cash.
config.ayuda: Set how your business looks and works here: language and theme, details, printers, team, closings and plan. One block opens at a time and its title stays pinned while you scroll.
super.zip.conFallos: Backup downloaded, but {fallidas} of {total} photos could not be fetched (details are in LEEME.txt inside the zip).
despacho.datoAyuda: Every ticket shows room, table, who sent it and at what time. Tap ✓ when the dish goes out.
despacho.directaAyuda: Counter sales waiting to be handed over land here, plus items tagged with the “Counter sale” area.
venta.comandaAyuda: Prints the kitchen ticket in each area (kitchen, bar, counter sale) and keeps the order in Expedition until it is handed over.
salon.zonaMesasTitulo: This room still has {n} table(s). What should we do with them?
salon.zonaMesasConCuenta: Cannot delete: table {mesa} has an open bill. Close or void it first.
salon.zonaEliminadaMesas: Room deleted and its {n} table(s) moved to {destino}
salon.zonaEliminadaConMesas: Room deleted along with its {n} table(s)
